title: Node killed
description: two controlled renox-workers, control/api sweeping every 5 s (unhealthy after 30 s), file replica; the owner of a tenant killed with SIGKILL after 10 s of writes (B18)
result: RTO > 180 s, RPO — s, 6262 rows lost, bystander 2061×200
target: RTO ≤ 60 s, RPO ≤ 10 s (B18), no error for a tenant on the surviving node

checks.name: RTO ≤ 60 s
checks.detail: no 200 on node-chaos-1 within 180 s of SIGKILL

notes: Both nodes run on one host (loopback); the two-host B18 run is O3 (#158).

Cause (diagnosed in this session): the worker's heartbeat (crates/renox-cell/src/control/mod.rs) has no `sent_at`, which control-messages.schema.json requires, so control/api answers 400 ('heartbeat refused') and every node turns unhealthy 30 s after it registers; failover then has no healthy candidate. With `sent_at` added (a local, uncommitted patch) the same harness gave node-kill PASS (RTO 32.8 s, RPO 0.79 s, bystander 415×200) and control-plane-down PASS.
